standard.summary: 使用 PyTorch 2.0+ 的 torch.compile 将模型 forward 编译为优化的 CUDA kernel，消除 Python 解释器开销和冗余的 kernel launch。通常可提速 10-30%，首次编译需要几十秒到几分钟。
standard.effect: 编译后 Python 层面的 for 循环、条件分支、中间 tensor 创建等开销被消除，多个小 kernel 被融合为一个。在 Anima/Newbie DiT 模型上效果更明显（因为 DiT 有大量重复的 Transformer block），SDXL UNet 上提升约 10-15%。

recommendedValues.off: 默认。调试阶段或不确定兼容性时保持关闭
recommendedValues.on + dynamic=true: 使用 bucket 多分辨率时必须开启 dynamic 模式
recommendedValues.on + fullgraph=true: 整个 forward 编译为一个图，最大化加速但不能有任何 Python 控制流
recommendedValues.compile_runtime=compile_cache: 编译产物缓存到磁盘，后续启动跳过编译

standard.whenToUse: PyTorch 2.4+ 且训练 shape 相对稳定时推荐开启。配合 compile_cache_enabled=True 可以将编译结果持久化到磁盘，第二次及以后启动不需要重新编译。compile_probe_enabled 会在训练前做 3 步性能探测，确认编译确实有收益才继续使用。
standard.avoidWhen: 与 block swap 不兼容（training_loop.py 会显式检查并禁止同时使用）。动态 batch size 时需要 dynamic=True 否则每次 batch 变化都会重新编译。SD1.5 小模型上编译开销可能抵消收益。

standard_en.summary: Uses PyTorch 2.0+'s torch.compile to compile the model forward pass into optimised CUDA kernels, removing the Python interpreter overhead and redundant kernel launches. Usually 10-30% faster, with a first compile taking tens of seconds to a few minutes.
standard_en.effect: After compilation the Python-level for loops, conditional branches, intermediate tensor creation and so on are gone, and several small kernels are fused into one. The effect is clearer on Anima/Newbie DiT models (because a DiT has many repeated Transformer blocks); on the SDXL UNet the gain is about 10-15%.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended on PyTorch 2.4+ when the training shapes are reasonably stable. With compile_cache_enabled=True the compilation result is persisted to disk, so the second and later starts need no recompilation. compile_probe_enabled runs a 3-step performance probe before training and only carries on once it confirms compilation really pays.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Incompatible with block swap (training_loop.py checks for this explicitly and refuses to use both). With a dynamic batch size you need dynamic=True, or every change of batch triggers a recompile. On a small SD1.5 model the compilation overhead may cancel out the gain.

recommendedValues.off: The default. Keep it off while debugging or when unsure about compatibility
recommendedValues.on + dynamic=true: Dynamic mode is required when using multi-resolution buckets
recommendedValues.on + fullgraph=true: Compiles the whole forward pass into one graph for maximum speed, but no Python control flow is then allowed
recommendedValues.compile_runtime=compile_cache: Caches the compilation output to disk so later starts skip compilation

advanced.principle: torch.compile 通过 TorchDynamo 在 Python 字节码层面捕获计算图（FX graph），然后 Inductor 后端将图编译为 Triton/CUDA C++ kernel。fullgraph 模式要求整个 forward 函数被捕获为一个图——任何 graph break（如 data-dependent control flow）都会导致编译失败。dynamic=True 允许输入 shape 变化（通过 symbolic shape），但生成的 kernel 可能不如 static shape 版本优化。CUDAGraph 更进一步，将整个 kernel 序列录制为 CUDA Graph，回放时消除所有 kernel launch overhead。
advanced.intervention: trainer.py 在模型构建后调用 model = torch.compile(model, backend=compile_backend, mode=compile_mode, dynamic=compile_dynamic, fullgraph=compile_fullgraph)。compile_scope='per_block' 时逐 block 编译（适合 DiT 有大量相同 block 的模型）。compile_runtime='cudagraph' 在前几步 warmup 后用 CUDA Graph 录制并重放。
advanced.expectedImpact: Anima LoRA 1024px batch=1（RTX 4090）：无编译 ≈ 1.8 it/s；compile ≈ 2.2 it/s（+22%）；compile + cudagraph ≈ 2.4 it/s（+33%）。SDXL LoRA 编译加速约 10-15%（UNet 已经比较优化）。对 LoRA 质量无影响（数学等价）。
advanced.tradeoffs: compile_cache_root 指定缓存目录（默认 model.cache），compile_cache_reuse 控制是否复用已有缓存。compile_shape_strategy 控制 static shape 策略：fixed_pad 将输入 pad 到固定大小，token_flatten 展平 token 维度，native 不强制固定。compile_target_strategy='block' 逐 block 编译，'inner_forward' 编译内部 forward，'auto' 自动选择。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:torch.compile(model) → TorchDynamo capture → Inductor compile → optional CUDAGraph record/replay

advanced_en.principle: torch.compile captures the compute graph (FX graph) at the Python bytecode level via TorchDynamo, then the Inductor backend compiles it into Triton/CUDA C++ kernels. fullgraph mode requires the entire forward function to be captured as one graph — any graph break (e.g. data-dependent control flow) fails compilation. dynamic=True allows varying input shapes (via symbolic shapes), but the generated kernels may be less optimized than static-shape versions. CUDAGraph goes further, recording the whole kernel sequence as a CUDA Graph and replaying it, eliminating all kernel launch overhead.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer.py calls model = torch.compile(model, backend=compile_backend, mode=compile_mode, dynamic=compile_dynamic, fullgraph=compile_fullgraph) after model construction. With compile_scope='per_block' it compiles block by block (suited to DiT models with many identical blocks). compile_runtime='cudagraph' records and replays a CUDA Graph after a few warmup steps.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Anima LoRA 1024px batch=1 (RTX 4090): no compile ≈ 1.8 it/s; compile ≈ 2.2 it/s (+22%); compile + cudagraph ≈ 2.4 it/s (+33%). SDXL LoRA compile speedup is about 10-15% (the UNet is already fairly optimized). No effect on LoRA quality (mathematically equivalent).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: compile_cache_root specifies the cache directory (default model.cache), compile_cache_reuse controls whether existing caches are reused. compile_shape_strategy controls the static shape strategy: fixed_pad pads inputs to a fixed size, token_flatten flattens the token dimension, native does not force fixing. compile_target_strategy='block' compiles per block, 'inner_forward' compiles the inner forward, 'auto' chooses automatically.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:torch.compile(model) → TorchDynamo capture → Inductor compile → optional CUDAGraph record/replay
